# Insyra With Me

> Community blog for Insyra, a Go data analysis ecosystem. Guides, stories and news from the Insyra community.

This site is https://insyra.me. It is the community blog (Insyra With Me), not the official Insyra documentation.

## Official Insyra

- Official site: https://insyra.hazelnut-paradise.com
- Documentation: https://hazelnutparadise.github.io/insyra/
- Source and README: https://github.com/HazelnutParadise/insyra
- Go package: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/HazelnutParadise/insyra

## This site

- Home: https://insyra.me/
- About / What is Insyra: https://insyra.me/about/
- Posts: https://insyra.me/posts/
- RSS: https://insyra.me/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://insyra.me/sitemap-index.xml
